name: Destroy the Asteroids
detailed_description:
Destroy the Asteroids and Save Earth!

Planet Earth is under attack! Swarms of giant asteroids are on a mission route, and hostile alien ships will do anything to stop your mission. In Destroy the Asteroids, you are the last line of defense! With a devastating arsenal and relentless challenges, your mission is simple: eliminate all threats before it’s too late!

🔥 Key Features 🔥

🚀 Defend humanity – Destroy asteroids before they reach the planet and fight off specific ships determined to destroy you.

💥 Powerful arsenal – Utilize black hole cannons, high-powered lasers, guided shots, and devastating bombs to destroy everything in your path!

🌌 Increasing Challenges – With each wave, the enemies become faster and more unpredictable. Do you have the reflexes and strategy to survive?

🎇 Total Immersion – Fight on the surface of the Moon with Earth in the background, feel the intense brightness of the Sun and immerse yourself in cinematic battles with epic explosions!

🎶 Dynamic Music – An electrifying soundtrack that adapts to the battles, heightening the tension in critical moments and celebrating your victory with epic music.

Grab your Oculus, enter the battle and prove that you are humanity’s last hope! Destroy the asteroids before they destroy Earth!🚀🌍🔥

short_description: Defend Earth against asteroids and alien ships!Use powerful weapons like lasers, black holes, and missiles to destroy threats and protect the planet. Challenges grow with each wave – only the fastest and most strategic will survive!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bits)
  • Processor: Intel i5-4590 / AMD Ryzen 5 1500X or higher
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580 or higher
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: SteamVR, Meta Quest (Link/AirLink)
  • Additional Notes: Requires SteamVR compatible VR headset
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64 bits)
  • Processor: Intel i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X or higher
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2070 / AMD Radeon 6700 XT or higher
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: SteamVR, Meta Quest (Link/AirLink)
  • Additional Notes: Better performance with SSD
